title: Portable document lifecycle and runnable Kit baseline
goal: Preserve work/design and repository-local rules while delivering a runnable portable baseline, dependency-bound versioned documentation and safe offline HTML through the canonical Foundry Kit.

exclude: Platform database and governed knowledge mutation
Other repositories during W002 review freeze
Live Slack/Hermes operations, host trust or credential configuration
Uncontrolled fleet install/update and Project Store rebinding

non_goals: New authentication, central server, web application, vector database, or semantic runtime
Canonical Vault promotion or historical decision rewriting
Automatic destructive cleanup or production proof from local synthetic fixtures
Git staging, commit, remote configuration, push, PR, merge, release or deploy

acceptance.statement: An explicit baseline-plus-extension install boots real work/design validation in a new repository without private domain dependencies; current local rules and host trust remain intact.
evidence: host adapter parity and available native smoke

acceptance.statement: Exact package and installed inventories, three-way update/reinstall/uninstall and fault recovery reject drift and preserve unrelated files, settings and Store bindings.
Complete diff/dependency impact and hash-bound review include rename, delete, doc-only changes and pinned ontology changes; incomplete scans and stale reviews cannot pass.

Single-authority metadata separates authority, lifecycle, freshness, security and release; all active retrieval/index/context surfaces enforce qualified IDs, canonical uniqueness and pre-output filters.
Deterministic offline HTML and release indexes derive from reviewed owner sources, reject generated drift, preserve audience-specific guidance, and pass XSS/privacy/accessibility/print/mobile checks.
Section preservation, scoped post-review gardening and exact approval/hash/retention/backup deletion guards preserve user backups and canonical history; real cleanup stays report-only.
Cross-app views remain Project Store projections, dependency recovery is authoritative, completed work can be read without reactivation, and default progress output never exposes a lease credential.
Existing full Foundry verification, current documentation and three sequential independent reviews pass, with local versus unavailable host/target evidence explicitly distinguished.

operational: No live Slack or production activation
Unavailable target or native host smoke is NOT PASS

decisions: Existing D-046: preserve controller/V2, no imported semantic runtime
Existing D-053: canonical Kit is tools/amplai-loop-kit
Existing D-056: Python 3.6 Kit compatibility, no implicit Store rebinding or supervisor activation
Original user goal authorizes local portable Kit implementation; later D002 authorizes only four exact UI Git initializations

Existing approved D-055 resolves the stale skill-canonical-location claim; preserve its original statement/provenance and supersede only that local index entry before implementation Context Pack selection.

Baseline dependency closure requires the existing task validator/generator/template support and local runtime schemas; pyproject changes are limited to the managed-tool verification boundaries required by D-056. No Platform or Vault schema change.

2026-09-11 user explicitly accepted remaining defect repair, shared document/Kit implementation and app-specific RPM preparation, then instructed continuation toward the original goal; execution-authorization.json records this authority. No live deployment or Git publication inferred.

S08 integration requires current operating-guide ownership sidecars, exact review store, protected guide example correction and bounded prior-slice robustness repairs; s08-scope-refinement.json records these within E021 local Kit/docs authority. No approval/agent/knowledge governance rule or Store schema is weakened.
